header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received.
Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of the
body: respondent No.2, taken on record. Record reflects that this petition was filed in the year 2021 and lastly fixed in Court on 06.04.2022. Thereafter, no efforts have been made by the counsel for the petitioner to get fix the matter in Court and to proceed with the matter. It appears that counsel for the petitioner has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
